## Guidelines
- Ignore composer packages in `/include/vendor` and all `node_modules` directories for analysis.
- Prefer using built-in project/framework functions over native PHP solutions when alternatives exist (e.g., use `html()` instead of PHP's `htmlspecialchars()` / `htmlescape()`).
- Resolve PHP commands using `php8` in the local PATH, or fallback to the full path of the MAMP PHP binary: `/Applications/MAMP/bin/php/php8.2.31/bin/php`.
